capabilities: Save a wikilink's alias to the target note's frontmatter via command
Find or create the target note of the link under the cursor
disambiguation: Not a note-renaming tool; it only stores link aliases in the target note's YAML frontmatter.
extras: Only one of several planned features is implemented so far; the README describes a single command (save-alias).
problem: Obsidian lets you write aliases in wikilinks, but nothing records those aliases in the target note's properties.
summary: Alias manager that saves a wikilink's alias into the target note's frontmatter list of aliases via a command.
